input-field.name: sandbox
input-field.label: Sandbox mode
沙箱模式
input-field.helpText: Enabled by default. Disable it and use the production gateway before going live.
默认开启，走沙箱网关。上线前关闭并使用正式网关。

input-field.name: private_key
input-field.label: Application private key
应用私钥
input-field.helpText: The signing half generated under Open Platform, Development settings, Interface signing. Upload the application public key to Alipay instead of entering it here.
签名用的那一半。在开放平台「开发设置 → 接口加签方式」里生成，与应用公钥成对；应用公钥只上传给支付宝，不要填在这里。

input-field.name: alipay_public_key
input-field.label: Alipay public key
支付宝公钥
input-field.helpText: The Alipay public key from the same page, used to verify signatures; this is not the application public key.
验签用的那一半，是同一页面里「支付宝公钥」那一栏的值，不是你的应用公钥。

input-field.name: gateway_url
input-field.label: Gateway URL
网关地址
input-field.helpText: Leave empty for the default gateway. Sandbox mode selects the sandbox gateway automatically.
留空使用默认网关；开启沙箱模式时自动使用沙箱网关。

input-field.name: op_app_id
input-field.label: Mini-program APPID
小程序 APPID
input-field.helpText: The mini program that opens the cashier, bound to JSAPI payment in the merchant platform. Leave empty to use the credential application APPID.
拉起收银台的小程序 APPID，须在商家平台与 JSAPI 支付产品绑定；留空使用凭据中的应用 APPID。
